primary.note: the primary estimates are the comparison and scope named here, per stratum; every other comparison and scope is secondary. primary.note_windows: for a cell on Windows this replaces the sentence of note on a cell without a prediction: such a cell has the comparison gt_obs only, and its scopes take the long trials from the oracle (the presses sent in the trial span at least limit_ms; deviation D3), so its primary estimates are gt_obs under under_limit with the definition windows_def.
